title: What It Really Costs to Own a McLaren F1 Today
description:
In twenty twenty-one, a McLaren F one sold at auction for twenty point four six five million dollars. That is more than two hundred fifty years of the median American household income, by our own arithmetic. But the purchase price is only the beginning. Today we work out what it really costs to own a McLaren F one, from the sticker price in nineteen ninety-two to the insurance bill. Here is the twist. For the first fourteen years of its life, the F one barely gained any value. Then it became one of the best-performing cars in history. So the real cost of owning one depends enormously on when you bought it, and the people who paid the original price got a very different deal from the people buying today.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
